description: Use when an agent must check if a wallet's loans are near liquidation. Input: address, optional chain (base, ethereum, arbitrum, all). Output: JSON per chain Aave v3 collateral, debt, borrowing power, LTV, health factor and liquidation distance %; Compound v3 supplied/borrowed base asset and isLiquidatable; summary with the lowest health factor. Read from contracts. Example: ?address=0x6246eee0355Dd7A93C888fE59e1151388A0cC5a1 Price: $0.003 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

address.description: EVM wallet (EIP-55 checksum if mixed case). Bad address → 400 before payment (not charged)

name: defi_health
title: Lending health factor and liquidation risk for a wallet: Aave v3 and Compound v3 on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum
